default.notes: Apply online on the official evisacam.cm portal before travel — the approved eVisa is issued on arrival at Douala, Yaoundé-Nsimalen or Garoua airports, or at an embassy; there is no visa without prior online approval.

groups.notes: CEMAC citizens enter Cameroon visa-free under the Community's free-movement arrangements — a valid passport or CEMAC travel document suffices for short stays.
Mali and Cameroon apply a long-standing bilateral visa waiver for short visits — confirm current terms with the nearest Cameroonian embassy before travel.

CM.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Cameroonian citizens.
